text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The GⅠ race: the Mile Championship. 
Emerging victorious from that fierce 
battle was Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Silence Suzuka says that 
feeling her passionate stride firsthand 
helped her realize what she had been 
missing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her aim for Hong Kong, Taiki 
Shuttle sought speed as well, setting her 
next target on the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The curtains fall on the Mile 
Championship. Now all that remains is to 
wait for the results. Will she be able to 
achieve her goal?
